summary: Fleet create_handoff and plan_fleet_from_intent block on durable would_pause_next_cycle or critical/exhausted budget pressure even when remaining tokens > 0, matching loops/PM/AutonomyEngine surface rails (#634/#869).
migration_impact: Live fleet plans/handoffs may refuse create under risk=off when remaining is below per_cycle. Raise token_budget, wait for UTC day rollover, or pass explicit use_live_budget=false with caller-owned remaining.
agent_notes: Do not open fleet handoffs when budget_pressure is critical/exhausted or would_pause_next_cycle is true. Resolve budget_gate first; PM dispatch inherits via create_handoff.
